definitions.explanation: A report describing the current condition or situation of a project, system, or task.

examples.japanese: {状態報告|じょうたいほうこく}を{受|う}ける。
{毎朝|まいあさ}システムの{状態報告|じょうたいほうこく}が{届|とど}く。
examples.english: A status report on the system arrives every morning.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{各|かく}チームが{現在|げんざい}の{状態報告|じょうたいほうこく}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: At the meeting, each team gave a status report on the current situation.

notes:
Formed from {状態|じょうたい} (state, condition) + {報告|ほうこく} (report). Common in business and technical settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {状態報告|じょうたいほうこく}を{行|おこな}う: to give a status report
- システムの{状態報告|じょうたいほうこく}: system status report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}: progress report — focuses on how far work has advanced
- {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}: update on recent circumstances — more personal
